intervention: four detector checkpoints only; shared camera/estimated Head/shape/hand settings
observation_policy: 12 anatomically mapped body joints; require finite prediction in both images for all four models, common joint-view mask; retain low confidence
primary: qualitative mesh overlays and downloadable SMPL-X coefficients; no ground-truth metrics
fixed_mixed_route: Use archived baseline accepted 3D targets and their covariances; otherwise use the same valid 2D views. Retriangulate only coordinates of already accepted 3D targets. Never change mask, covariance, group normalizer or shape subspace across interventions.
shape_policy: fixed mean shape; zero basis, no triangulated 3D targets
selection: Lowest feasible training objective at fixed checkpoints, no body-3D GT or output 3D error used
scope: single real stereo pair, historical estimated head and calibration; no 3D truth; fixed local hand pose
